scope: Main-text Figures 2, 3 and 4 only. No point clouds, neighbor arrays, unused diagnostic arrays, or appendix runs.

2.retained_fields: Mean absolute relative error per family, method, and seed for HomID and isometric spheres.
2.aggregation: Each seed first averages absolute relative error across all saved fixed_N, fixed_k and fixed_kN sweeps in an instantiation, then averages instantiations equally. Across seeds, take nanmean. Plot HomID mean / sphere mean - 1. Text uncertainty is the sum of the two across-seed population SDs, exactly as in the original plot. It is not a propagated ratio error.
2.source_selection: Original score_ide_bm source selection including its fallback behavior; sphere values replaced by isometry_score_ide_bm from compare_review (large, then small, then temp). The exporter executes the original read-only functions. Unused baseline branches are read by those functions but their data is not retained.

3.retained_fields: Per-seed mean signed relative error and within-seed local population SD, epsilon grid, dimensions, seeds, method and family labels.
3.aggregation: Within a seed use nanmean(lides)/d_i-1 and nanstd(lides)/d_i. Average each quantity across seeds with nanmean; shade mean +/- mean local SD.
3.presentation_adjustments: Axis labels corrected to x=epsilon and y=delta. Original cell 11 interchanged these labels. Numeric curves and shading are unchanged.

4.retained_fields: Per-seed mean signed relative error and within-seed local population SD, original sigma-squared grid, dimensions, seeds, noise type, method and family labels.
4.aggregation: Within a seed use mean(lides)/d_i-1 and std(lides)/d_i. Average each quantity across seeds with nanmean; shade mean +/- mean local SD at alpha=0.01. The input sigma parameter denotes noise variance in this experiment.

missing_values.treatment: Original NaN retained. Across-seed nanmean/nanstd omit this entry, as in the original plotting notebook.
